about: Recommended settings per game and device class (gb.frame.GameProfiles / DeviceTier): low = little cores only (e.g. Rockchip RK3566), mid = 2 fast cores or fewer, or Cortex-A73-class big cores (e.g. Unisoc T618, Snapdragon G1 Gen 2, Snapdragon 662; threadedAudio only applies with 2 fast cores), high = 3+ fast cores; GPU capacity is considered separately for the app profile. Only "all" and the device's own class apply. Keys: renderer (cpu | gpu), threadedAudio (true | false), frameSkip (true | false), idleSkip (false: no SH-2 idle-loop skipping), threadedVdp (false: VDP1/VDP2 rendered on the emulation thread). idleSkip and threadedVdp are not user options: set them to false (usually under "all") only for a game that misbehaves with them. Values come from performance logs on real devices; add a game only with measurements.
